meta.name: ai-observability
meta.description: Implement comprehensive observability for LLM applications including tracing (Langfuse/Helicone), cost tracking, token optimization, RAG evaluation metrics (RAGAS), hallucination detection, and production monitoring. Essential for debugging, optimizing costs, and ensuring AI output quality. Use when ", llm-monitoring, tracing, langfuse, helicone, cost-tracking, ragas, evaluation, hallucination-detection, prompt-caching" mentioned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 监控并优化大模型应用的性能与成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在生产环境中运行LLM应用，需要追踪调用、评估质量并控制成本。
copy.tagline_en: Monitor and optimize LLM app performance and cost
copy.fit_line_en: For you if running LLM apps in production and need tracing, evaluation, and cost control.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会指导你为LLM应用添加跟踪、成本监控、令牌优化、RAG评估和幻觉检测，帮助你调试并提升AI输出质量。
howto.when: 当你提到“llm-monitoring”、“tracing”、“langfuse”等关键词，或要求实施LLM应用的可观测性时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置Langfuse追踪每次LLM调用。
如何用RAGAS评估回答的忠实度？
监控生产环境的AI成本并设定预算。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you in adding tracing, cost monitoring, token optimization, RAG evaluation, and hallucination detection for LLM applications, helping debug and improve AI output quality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "llm-monitoring", "tracing", "langfuse", or ask to implement observability for LLM applications.

say_en.text: Help me set up Langfuse to trace each LLM call.
How to evaluate answer faithfulness with RAGAS?
say_en.note: Claude guides on running the evaluation.

say_en.text: Monitor AI costs in production and set budgets.
